newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian soothsayer urges army ruler to quit.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian soothsayer urges army ruler to quit.

text.p: A prominent Nigerian soothsayer has urged military ruler General Sani Abacha to step down and ignore people urging him to run for election as a civilian president.

"I call on our listening head of state to avoid straining his luck too far," Theophilus Olabayo, founder of the Evangelical Church of Yahweh, said at a book launching in Lagos on Monday, adding: "Please do not challenge your chin to a fight."
Abacha seized power during post-election chaos in 1993 and has pledged to hand over to an elected president in 1998.

Olabayo, who has a record of accurately predicting major events in Nigeria and enjoys a large following, urged Abacha to "keep faith" with his 1998 appointment lest he bring "confusion" upon the country.
